eb20822b0dca4dbeb4caf9291ec8224e.overview: Gigli is ordered to kidnap the psychologically challenged younger brother of a powerful federal prosecutor. When plans go awry, Gigli's boss sends in Ricki, a gorgeous free-spirited female gangster who has her own set of orders to assist with the kidnapping. But Gigli begins falling for the decidedly unavailable Ricki, which could be a hazard to his occupation.
eb20822b0dca4dbeb4caf9291ec8224e.tagline: Life doesn't play by the rules.

eb26bae3f51840eddc0d5e85829544e9.overview: Capturing John Lennon, Paul McCartney, George Harrison and Ringo Starr in their electrifying element, 'A Hard Day's Night' is a wildly irreverent journey through this pastiche of a day in the life of The Beatles during 1964. The band have to use all their guile and wit to avoid the pursuing fans and press to reach their scheduled television performance, in spite of Paul's troublemaking grandfather and Ringo's arrest.
eb26bae3f51840eddc0d5e85829544e9.tagline: The Beatles, starring in their first full-length, hilarious, action-packed film!

eb4d8f2695a3c3794365360107eddec5.overview: Chronicles three years of a middle-class family seemingly caught up in their daily routines, troubled only by minor incidents. Behind their apparent calm and repetitive existence, however, they're planning something much more sinister.

eb7887afcc2ec243c5eebbcf6bb6ec16.overview: Desiring control of the kingdom, evil wizard Pendragon devises a cunning machination to usurp the throne. By abducting and forcing Princess Elaine to marry him, Pendragon will coerce the king into abdicating his power. When Pendragon sends a giant to kidnap Elaine, a simple farmer named Jack witnesses the abduction, and bravely slays the beast. Undeterred, Pendragon has more power and creatures at his disposal.
eb7887afcc2ec243c5eebbcf6bb6ec16.tagline: A pretty princess. An evil sorcerer. A hero for the ages.

ebb6f6d7015ee8b6977ba527c00c69a1.overview: Years after a desperate teenage Linda gives up her baby for adoption, she finds herself face-to-face with Martin, a young man claiming to be her long-lost son. Linda embraces Martin and in him finds a welcome reprieve from her unhappy marriage to the neglectful Henry. But soon Martin grows violent and becomes obsessed with Henry -- a philandering man whose only offspring is an expansive model train set that devours his waking hours.
ebb6f6d7015ee8b6977ba527c00c69a1.tagline: Was he her dream or obsession? Was she his mother or his lover?

ebd961c1dfe636aff266c50708ba2889.overview: Guests at a posh Berlin hotel struggle through worry, scandal, and heartache.
ebd961c1dfe636aff266c50708ba2889.tagline: Thank the stars for a great entertainment!

ebef30baea33420364347c2c1f2bdfc9.overview: Acclaimed for his unfiltered reporting and deadpan humor, Andrew Callaghan brings his gonzo style reporting to the undercurrents that led to the January 6 Capitol Riot. As one of the best-known and hardest working journalists of his generation, the 25-year-old ventures on a wild RV journey through America to take the pulse of a divided nation.
